findings.what: The original `.max(START_DEADLINE)` was a floor, and the commit changed it to `.min`, which turns START_DEADLINE into a ceiling. Every staged start is now capped at START_DEADLINE, so the client gives up before the daemon on any multi-stage start, and small batches get less than the floor the doc comment promises. The doc comment says the result is never under START_DEADLINE and is deliberately not clamped.
